title: Overbright asset format: an engine table override (ob.engine-table)
description: engine-tables.md 3. tables/<table>.toml in a mod pack or a community base set (never an imported one, TBL.7): new values for one of the engine's built-in tables. The value shapes are not in this schema: they are the built-in table's (generated from the code) and checked by the reader (TBL.3).

table.description: The table's name (= the file name without .toml).

op.description: merge (default): the set entries; replace: value is the whole table.

made_for.description: The built-in table's pin (sha256 of its Debug text, FIELD_PINS) the pack was made against. A different pin is a warning.

value.description: op = replace: the whole table, in the table's shape.

at.description: The path into the table: array indices (from 0) and struct field names.

value.description: The new value of that part, in its shape.

guard.description: The built-in value at that path the author changed; refused when it differs (TBL.5).
